Lessons.Title: Order Multi-digit Numbers
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will compare and order multi-digit whole numbers within 1,000,000.
Previously, you reasoned about place value to compare pairs of multi-digit numbers. In this lesson, you continue to do so as you apply your reasoning to put whole numbers in order of size. - Engagement
Core relationship: Order whole numbers by place value. Compare the leading differing digit and arrange all given numbers consistently.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  True or False: Decomposed Numbers	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Ways to Compare	 (25 minutes); Activity 2:  Video Game Scores	 (10 minutes); Cool-down:  From Least to Greatest	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: What is the difference between 35,100 and 31,500?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Order 30,510; 35,100; 31,500 from least to greatest.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
